plan: Keep queueing midlane as primary — it is already Willy's usual queue AND best role at 51.1% over 295 games (overall is 50.0%).
Comfort-hero rule for the climb: Lt. Belica. Compared with the average player on the same hero, Willy wins about 3.7 more games per 100 on it.
Willy's champion pool is 8+ heroes wide and the top three are only 49% of the games. Gold-to-Platinum climbs are almost always pool-narrowing stories: aim for 70%+ of games on the top three.
The math: Willy is at 643 VP; Platinum III starts at 900. The all-time peak is 903 — Platinum-level rating has been touched once already; this is a consistency problem, not a ceiling problem.
honesty: personal winrates are shrunk toward the player's own average (small heater samples do not count as mains)
field baselines are all-ranks aggregates from our current-patch match sample, not Gold-bracket-specific yet
winrate edges are observational; they say where the player wins, not why
